country.name: Malawi

default_in_force_rule.text: Not applied: every version is dated by MalawiLII's own expression date, the day the amendment it incorporates took effect as Laws.Africa records it (for a consolidation, the date the revised edition is as at). No date is computed from a default rule.

sources.name: MalawiLII (hosted by the Gender and Justice Unit, on the Laws.Africa Peachjam platform)
sources.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0, crediting MalawiLII as the source (https://malawilii.org/terms-of-use/)
sources.notes: Point-in-time expressions of each act, /akn/mw/act/<year>/<num>/eng@<date>. MalawiLII's terms prohibit scraping and bulk downloading, so no MalawiLII page was fetched: each expression page is read from its latest Internet Archive capture (raw id_ form), and the capture timestamps and sha256s are pinned in sources.json. The request count is of Internet Archive requests.

sources.name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine
sources.licence: Archived copies of MalawiLII pages; the content licence is MalawiLII's
sources.notes: CDX API for discovery, then https://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<original url> for the page bytes.

ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote the configuration and the Malawi-specific scripts, and chose the acts. No model wrote, summarised or transformed legal text: parse.py is deterministic code.
